chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: The Cobb-McRae tenor team
summary: Hampton called McRae and Arnett Cobb his best tenor team, who worked out showmanship routines together.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
